# Framework Ecosystems Labs

Purpose: teach transferable framework engineering through one contract and comparable evidence.

Read first:
- README.md
- empezar/README.md
- PROMPT_MAESTRO.md
- curriculum/README.md
- docs/TAXONOMY.md
- contracts/taskflow/openapi.yaml
- catalog/frameworks.json
- atlas/README.md
- sources/bibliography.json

Atlas:
- catalog/frameworks.json is the single source of truth: 138 technologies, 13 ecosystems.
- atlas/frameworks.md and atlas/fichas/README.md are generated by scripts/generate-atlas.mjs. Do not edit them by hand.
- Every technology in the catalog has one ficha in atlas/fichas/<id>.md, written by hand.
- Every factual claim carries a [@id] citation resolved against sources/bibliography.json.

Onboarding:
- empezar/ is the prologue: installation, prerequisites and the first green run.
- The toolchain table in empezar/README.md is generated by scripts/doctor.mjs from every implementaciones/*/ejecutar.json. Do not edit it by hand.
- scripts/lib/cadenas.mjs holds the install recipes; add a chain there when a class introduces a new ecosystem.

Rules:
- Verify changing facts in official sources.
- Keep the TaskFlow behavior stable across implementations.
- Use pnpm only for JavaScript and TypeScript workflows.
- Do not invent APIs, versions, benchmarks, licenses or support status.
- A catalog entry is not a recommendation.
- Every source must resolve: books by ISBN-13, papers by DOI, standards and references by live URL.
- Run pnpm check before proposing changes; it must stay green.
